matches.description: Compute the exact power of a truncated series in QQ[[x]]/(x^N) via binary exponentiation.

matches.description: Compute the exact Cauchy convolution of two truncated series in QQ[[x]]/(x^N).  Both operands must share the same variable and truncation order.
matches.title: Multiply two truncated formal power series

matches.description: Compute the composition F(G(x)) mod x^N.  The inner series G must have zero constant term.

matches.description: Compute the exact quotient Q = A/B modulo x^N, requiring b_0 != 0. Returns the exact residual B*Q - A.
matches.title: Divide two truncated formal power series

matches.description: Compute the multiplicative inverse B(x) of A(x) modulo x^N, requiring a_0 != 0.  Returns the exact product residual A*B - 1.
matches.title: Invert a truncated formal power series
